messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

You can now enter a **Deal name** in “Reproduce a game.” Named snapshots restore that name when loaded; unnamed snapshots remain compatible with the existing format. Names clear when you start or load a new deal.

Pasted snapshots now load regardless of the order of their JSON fields, while invalid snapshots still leave the current game unchanged.

Verification passed: 142 unit and static tests, 79 browser tests, and type checking. All changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 unrelated files with existing formatting differences.
